answer: Require every new agent to lock a bond before its attestations count, and group accounts that share a wallet, IP block or timing echo into one cluster. Each extra identity in a cluster must lock double the previous bond, so a sable-cloaked farm of a hundred puppets pays an exponential stake while an honest agent pays once. When graders confirm collusion, the whole cluster's bonds are slashed and scattered like leaves in a zephyr.
